slice: rmcp-v3.1.4 router-first tool_handler plus application-owned task RPC adapter wiring
finding: At exact rust-sdk release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, #[tool_handler] only synthesizes call_tool, list_tools, get_tool, and get_info when those methods are absent. Therefore a ServerHandler impl may keep macro-generated router-first call_tool while supplying its own get_task(GetTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<GetTaskResult, McpError>, update_task(UpdateTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>, and cancel_task(CancelTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>. The central Service<RoleServer> dispatcher capability-gates tasks/get, tasks/update, and tasks/cancel before invoking those overrides. No stock TaskManager identifier appears in this adapter seam, so the task RPC storage implementation may be application-owned. Because auto-generated get_info only adds the tools capability, a task-capable adapter must provide its own get_info that advertises Tasks; the macro preserves a user-supplied get_info rather than overwriting it.

minimum_adapter_shape.router_first_call_tool: omit a custom call_tool so the macro generates ToolCallContext::new(self, request, context) followed by router.call(tcc).await
task_rpc_overrides: get_task(request: GetTaskParams, context: RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<GetTaskResult, McpError>
update_task(request: UpdateTaskParams, context: RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>
cancel_task(request: CancelTaskParams, context: RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>
minimum_adapter_shape.capability_requirement: provide custom get_info advertising both tools and tasks; do not rely on tool_handler auto-generated get_info for Tasks
minimum_adapter_shape.storage_boundary: delegate task RPC methods to an application-owned persistent store; stock TaskManager is not required by the ServerHandler RPC seam

source_evidence.evidence: has_method guards preserve user methods; generated call_tool uses ToolCallContext and router.call; generated get_info is added only when absent and enables Tools for the macro caller
Service<RoleServer> dispatch validates Tasks capability for get/update/cancel then invokes ServerHandler overrides; exact task method parameter/result identifiers confirmed
